b:
The powerful store their
blood.
Mostly in round
mugs. A dog with
a dot, a deer with a dot.
Everything’s with
dots. People in
orange
overalls are harvesting
plants. Or
they’re picking up from the ground what
remained after the plants
they carried off. They’re
at work. The sky reddens.
Read Brian Henry's note on translating Tomaž Šalamun's poems in the November 2026 issue of Poetry.
